Workspace Backup & Restore

The Backup feature exports your entire Aura Engine state into a lightweight .JSON file, allowing you to migrate your progress to a different browser or PC.

What gets saved?

  • Engine Configurations: Custom EQ presets, Aura modifiers, colors, and layout configurations.
  • Track Metadata: Custom names, artists, play counts, attached lyrics (.lrc), and favorite status.
  • Playlists & History: Curated playlist structures, folders, and recent play history.
  • Aura Score & Ranks: Lifetime points, claimed achievements, and session states.

Important Limitation

The backup file DOES NOT contain your actual physical audio files (.mp3, .wav) or heavy custom image assets.

When you click Restore on a new setup, you will need to re-upload your raw audio files. The engine will instantly scan them, recognize the metadata, and re-link all your lyrics, play counts, and playlists automatically!

About

A next-generation audio-visual engine and premium music player. Experience deep immersion with high-fidelity Vivu-style transient visualizers, dynamic 8D surround panning, and a master 15-band Studio EQ. Legal Agreements & Consent

By accessing and utilizing the Music Player | Aura Engine V1.5, you formally acknowledge and provide explicit consent to our core operational frameworks. This includes local browser storage mechanics, telemetry analytics, and offline cache management.

We are committed to strict data transparency. Your synced directories, encrypted local backups, and semantic track metadata are processed exclusively within your localized environment. No personal data is transmitted to external servers without explicit manual export actions.

    Update Patch Notes

    14 Days, 00:00:00

    Update Deployed: 12 August 2026

    Welcome to Aura Engine V1.5! This is our biggest expansion yet, introducing the standalone desktop app, massive performance upgrades, and entirely new ways to experience your music:

    • [New Feature] Desktop Application: Launched the dedicated desktop client for the Music Player Aura Engine, featuring exclusive settings for native window and frameless app layouts.
    • [New Feature] Aura Score & Rank System: Deployed a gamified progression system with dynamic ranks, Aura Score tracking, and visually stunning tier upgrade cards to reward your listening sessions.
    • [New Feature] Achievements: Introduced a comprehensive achievements system and Bounty Board to track milestones and reward your engagement.
    • [New Feature] Aura Library & Playlists: Built the dedicated Aura Library panel for streamlined music management, complete with full custom playlist creation capabilities.
    • [New Feature] 8D Audio Panning: Integrated immersive 8D surround sound panning for a dynamic, moving audio experience across your stereo channels.
    • [New Feature] Full Screen & Mini Player: Deployed cinematic Full Screen mode for maximum visualizer immersion and a compact, floating Mini Player mode for versatile desktop viewing.
    • [New Feature] Visualizer Recorder: Added a native screen recorder so you can capture live visualizer sessions directly into video files without third-party software.
    • [New Feature] Watermark Stickers: Implemented draggable, customizable social media watermark stickers that you can place anywhere on the center stage.
    • [New Feature] Custom Stage Backgrounds & Art: You can now upload and manage custom stage background covers and track album arts. We also added a toggle to make the center stage transparent so your backgrounds shine through.
    • [New Feature] Aura Flash (Aurora Impact): Introduced the massive Aura Flash effect, featuring explosive radial blooms and directional silhouette flares that trigger on heavy bass drops.
    • [New Feature] Live Previews & Mirroring: Built an interactive, mirrored live preview for the 15-band Master Studio Equalizer and a live canvas preview window inside the Master Aura Modifiers dialog.
    • [New Feature] Floating Lyrics: Engineered a new Floating Action lyrics mode that dynamically spawns animated karaoke text floating around the active cover art.
    • [New Feature] FPS Tracker: Included a real-time FPS counter to help you monitor engine rendering performance.
    • [Upgraded] Export MP3 & WAV: Massively upgraded the audio exporter. You can now edit ID3 metadata tags, inject .lrc lyrics directly into the file, and export in lossless WAV format.
    • [Upgraded] Settings UI Restructure: Completely overhauled the Settings dialog into clean, categorized groups for much easier navigation.
    • [Upgraded] Playing Deck Enhancements: Upgraded the bottom playing deck to clearly display the active single track and its specific source label (e.g., File Upload, Playlist, Folder).
    • [Upgraded] Spike Aura Visuals: Enhanced the geometry and reactivity of the Spike Aura Ring and Silhouette modes, heavily optimizing the ultra-responsive Vivu style transients.
    • [Upgraded] Visual Scrolling Performance: Heavily optimized the rendering queue, bringing buttery smooth visual scrolling to both the standard file upload list and massive folder directories containing hundreds of tracks.
    • [Upgraded] Folder Sync: Added a dedicated Sync button to the Folder Upload panel, allowing the engine to scan and load your music directory instantly without manual file re-selection.
    • [Upgraded] Analytics & Favourites: Expanded the Analytics dashboard with deeper library metrics and uptime tracking, while upgrading the Favourites dialog with better sorting and playback integration.
    • [Adjustment] Optimized Rainbow Theme: Re-engineered the Rainbow aura color theme to decouple DOM CSS updates from the canvas loop, preventing layout thrashing and maintaining maximum frame rates.
    • [Adjustment] Export Shortcut: Mapped the Minus key on the keyboard as a quick shortcut to instantly open the Export Audio dialog.
    • [Adjustment] Library Panel Flow: Smoothed out the transition animations and UI feedback for the button that swaps between File Upload and Folder Upload views.
    • [Adjustment] Clear Playlist Unification: The Clear Playlist button functionality has been expanded and can now be used directly within the File upload panel.
    • [Fix] Floating Lyrics Optimization: Resolved a critical app crash and severe FPS drop caused by rendering complex lyrics text in the Floating Action focus mode.
    • [Fix] Folder Queue Latency: Eliminated the long loading delays and frame drops that triggered when playing tracks from a massive folder upload queue.
    • [Fix] Panel Swapping Crash: Fixed a memory leak and crash that occurred when rapidly swapping back and forth between the File Upload and Folder Upload panels.
    • [Fix] Day Theme Text: Fixed an issue where text visibility and contrast were broken while using the Light/Day theme.

    V1.5 Workspace Preview

    Update Deployed: 12 July 2026

    • [New Feature] Aura Analytics Dashboard equipped with real-time uptime calculation and library stats trackers.
    • [New Feature] Live-updating system clock counter embedded directly inside the Analytics panel.
    • [New Feature] Native browser storage quota analyzer parsing real-time IndexedDB megabyte usage.
    • [New Feature] Added "Floating Music Notes" Aura Modifier to spawn background melodies during playback.
    • [New Feature] Implemented a cinematic zoom-out splash screen and intro sequence upon initializing the application environment.
    • [New Feature] Added "Floating Action" DJ-style lyrics mode, featuring randomized off-screen spawn logic, collision scaling animations, and gravity swing physics.
    • [Upgraded] Expanded Studio EQ into 15 independent band sliders distributed across 5 pagination tracks (`< 1 / 5 >`).
    • [Upgraded] Added click focus bounds: `4`, `5`, and `6` key mapping toggles high-glow highlight outlines around active EQ slots.
    • [Upgraded] Bound custom EQ seek step preferences (`0.1`, `0.5`, `1.0` dB) from Settings to `Ctrl + Up/Down` hotkeys.
    • [Upgraded] Reforged 'Gravity' Spike Aura into a dynamic Soundwave Spiral Silhouette with elliptical symmetry and glowing gradients.
    • [Upgraded] Expanded Export MP3 settings with granular Audio Segment controls (Selectable 128-320 kbps Bitrate & 44.1/48kHz Sample Rates).
    • [Adjustment] Fully structured configuration state files to store, load, and retain custom EQ step preferences.
    • [Adjustment] Fixed runtime thread interception to prevent focused sliders from freezing standard app hotkeys.
    • [Adjustment] Smart duplicate track detection and auto-sync with Favourites upon file upload.
    • [Adjustment] Dynamic Play/Pause icon synchronization across all active library panels.
    • [Adjustment] Added accurate track duration calculations to the Info Dialog.
    • [Adjustment] Added horizontal auto-scroll logic for overflowing Artist names.
    • [Adjustment] Added global keyboard hotkeys: `+` for Favourite, `Del` for Remove Track/Clear Folder.
    • [Adjustment] Fully structured configuration state files to retain precise UI visual slider synchronizations on cold application boots.
    • [Fix] Enforced strict cross-reference parsing during startup cycles to ensure favorite star icons load in synchronization.
    • [Fix] Forced sound engine callback parameters to apply Reverb audio contexts on cold reloads.
    • [Fix] Added Estimated MP3 Length calculation in the Export Audio window.

    V1.2 Workspace Preview

    Initial Release: V1.0 (06 July 2026)

    The foundational architecture of the Aura Engine.

    • [Feature] Dual Canvas Aura Engine: We built a high performance two layer HTML5 Canvas system. This cleanly separates ambient background effects like rain, snow, cubes, and flicker from the reactive foreground audio visualizers like the center stage towers, spikes, and expanding particles.
    • [Feature] Web Audio API Core: The heart of the app is the central Audio Engine. It features dual track loading for seamless crossfade transitions, plus dynamic controls for playback speed, volume, and impulse response convolution reverb.
    • [Feature] Master Studio Equalizer: We integrated a 10 band BiquadFilter equalizer from 32Hz up to 16kHz. This is coupled with PreAmp, SubBass, and stereo Panning controls, all fully visualized by a real time Left and Right stereo spectrum canvas.
    • [Feature] Spike Aura Geometries: Introduced the reactive center stage visualizer. It comes in two distinct forms: the standard Circular Ring layout and the Soundwave Spiral Silhouette Gravity mode.
    • [Feature] ID3 Metadata and Library Management: We implemented jsmediatags for local file parsing. It automatically extracts embedded cover art, titles, and artist data directly into your virtualized drag and drop playlist workspace.
    • [Feature] Folder Directory Sync: Created a 3D flipping library panel that lets you seamlessly toggle your workspace between standard individual files and entire local directory folder imports.
    • [Feature] Synchronized Karaoke Engine: Developed a .lrc parsing system that maps lyric timestamps to the audio progression. It features a dedicated auto scrolling focus mode that elegantly blurs the background elements.
    • [Feature] Offline MP3 Compiler: We integrated lamejs so you can render your active audio buffer completely client side. This bakes your custom EQ and Reverb states directly into a downloadable .mp3 file.
    • [Feature] Workspace Backup and Restore: Engineered a JSON serialization system. Now you can export your entire environment state including configurations, playlists, and metadata, then restore it seamlessly during another session.
    • [Feature] Global Hotkey Architecture: We mapped essential playback, deck adjustments for Volume, Speed, and Reverb, and UI toggles for Theme and Lyrics directly to keyboard shortcuts for rapid desktop navigation.
    • [Feature] Dynamic Aura Themes: Established a robust CSS variable overriding system. This allows live toggling between Light and Dark modes, plus 7 distinct gemstone inspired color palettes like Ruby, Bronze, Gold, Emerald, Diamond, Sapphire, and Amethyst.
    • [Feature] Cover Art Physics: Implemented reactive CSS keyframe animations for the center stage album art. You get Swinging and Rotating idle motions, coupled with Pop or Shake beat reactive impacts.

      How to Earn Points

      • Playback (Passive): +2 pts (10s run), +5 pts (per min), +10 pts (track completion).
      • Library Management: +20 pts (per active Favourite), +2 pts (attaching .lrc lyrics).
      • Engine Uptime: +1 pt (per minute of application running).
      • Rendering & Export: +100 pts (MP3 track exported), +50 pts (Base MP4 Video), +150 pts (1st Min recorded), +250 pts (Per extra minute).
      • Daily Caps (Customization): +15 pts (Create Playlist, max 3/day), +10 pts (Stage Bg, max 3/day), +5 pts (Custom Art, max 3/day), +1 pt (Apply EQ Preset, max 10/day).
